modules.rationale: Synchronous API shape is a better fit than node-sqlite3; still requires ABI-matched OHOS build and device proof.
requiredInputs: Electron/OpenHarmony Node headers matching the host
modules.buildCommand: Install dependencies first, then locate node_modules/better-sqlite3 and run node scripts/ohos-tools.mjs build-native
modules.deployTarget: ohos_hap/electron/libs/arm64-v8a/ plus JS binding rewrite to /data/storage/el1/bundle/libs/arm64/<addon>.node when required
verification: hdc hilog has no ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED or wrong ELF class
feature-level smoke test exercises the addon, not only require()

modules.rationale: libvips toolchain is heavy; prefer WASM/service fallback unless native performance is essential.
requiredInputs: Electron/OpenHarmony Node headers matching the host
modules.buildCommand: Install dependencies first, then locate node_modules/sharp and run node scripts/ohos-tools.mjs build-native
modules.deployTarget: ohos_hap/electron/libs/arm64-v8a/ plus JS binding rewrite to /data/storage/el1/bundle/libs/arm64/<addon>.node when required
verification: hdc hilog has no ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED or wrong ELF class
feature-level smoke test exercises the addon, not only require()

globalGates: Do not reuse macOS/Windows/Linux prebuilt .node artifacts.
Measure process.versions.modules on the target HarmonyOS PC before accepting ABI compatibility.
Re-run this plan whenever host tag, Electron version, dependency lockfile, or native SDK changes.
Every rebuilt .node must pass audit-node.sh and a feature-level device test.
